Class ContributorStoryTests

java.lang.Object
guiLessons.ContributorStoryTests
public final class ContributorStoryTests extends Object

Title: ContributorStoryTests Class.

Description: Named positive and negative scenarios derived from the supplied Contributor (Phase Two) stories. C01-C12 refer to RequirementsToTests.md. Each method documents its requirement, implementation, and output oracle. Runs inside LessonTestingAutomation on the JavaFX thread and its isolated H2 connection. Admin is the privileged-role fixture; Phase Three AI behavior is design scope, not claimed as implemented.
